title: check_reorder_need input
description: Model-facing parameters only. The caller's role is injected by the orchestration layer and is deliberately absent here, so that no instruction inside a document can claim a role it does not hold.

review_date.description: Date of the weekly review the officer is conducting. PRO-001-C01.

skus.description: Restrict the scan to these SKUs. Omit to evaluate the whole snapshot.

location.description: Restrict the scan to one store. Omit or null for both.

include_sufficient.description: Include items above their reorder point. Off by default; the reorder list is the deliverable.
